searchText: Thanks, so if the val key is loaded on the client, the pre exit can be generated before funding the vals? In addition you can generate the pre exit without using the index according to the doc here by using the MNEMONIC and only the public key of the validator https://github.com/eth-educators/ethstaker-guides/blob/main/voluntary-exit.md#required-details No. You cannot create a validator exit transaction before it has an on-chain index (mnemonic indices are totally different). Ok and index is assigned when the validator key is funded or only when the concensus client loaded the key? When the deposit is recognized on the beacon chain (the "pending" state at https://www.attestant.io/posts/understanding-the-validator-lifecycle/) Thanks, now it's clear One more thing the documentation that I shared gives the impression that you can just replace the index with the public key to generate the pre-signed exit offline. It's from github; feel free to raise an issue or PR to address that (but it isn't anything to do with this discord so I doubt anyone here can do anything about it).

excerpts.author: n0price
excerpts.content:
Thanks, so if the val key is loaded on the client, the pre exit can be generated before funding the vals? 
In addition you can generate the pre exit without using the index according to the doc here by using the MNEMONIC and only the public key of the validator  https://github.com/eth-educators/ethstaker-guides/blob/main/voluntary-exit.md#required-details

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: No.  You cannot create a validator exit transaction before it has an on-chain index (mnemonic indices are totally different).

excerpts.author: n0price
excerpts.content: Ok and index is assigned when the validator key is funded or only when the concensus client loaded the key?

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: When the deposit is recognized on the beacon chain (the "pending" state at https://www.attestant.io/posts/understanding-the-validator-lifecycle/)

excerpts.author: n0price
excerpts.content: One more thing the documentation that I shared gives the impression that you can just replace the index with the public key to generate the pre-signed exit offline.
